parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame forms the main structural body of the storage cabinet, made of plywood panels.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and houses the shelves and doors, maintaining the cabinet’s shape and stability.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that supports all other components.

parts.name: Shelf 1
parts.Basic_description: A horizontal plywood shelf inside the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It supports stored items and divides the cabinet interior into sections.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed in place and does not move.

parts.name: Shelf 2
parts.Basic_description: A middle shelf made of plywood, part of the cabinet’s internal structure.
parts.Functional_description: It provides additional storage space and supports items placed on it.

parts.name: Shelf 3
parts.Basic_description: Another internal shelf made of plywood.
parts.Functional_description: It divides the cabinet vertically and supports stored objects.

parts.name: Shelf 4
parts.Basic_description: The topmost internal shelf of the cabinet, made of plywood.
parts.Functional_description: It provides the uppermost storage surface inside the cabinet.

parts.name: Cabinet Door (Upper)
parts.Basic_description: The upper door of the cabinet made of MDF with a smooth finish.
parts.Functional_description: It covers and protects the upper storage compartment, allowing access when opened.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Door (Lower)
parts.Basic_description: The lower door of the cabinet made of MDF, similar to the upper door.
parts.Functional_description: It covers the lower storage compartment and provides access when opened.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about hinges to open and close.
